title: liparis khasiana
intro: Liparis khasiana, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Liparis khasiana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of Liparis khasiana as including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
